verdict.rationale: Recruitee shows candidate profiles with fields, emails in one place, activity tracking via audit logs (admin created/updated/merged candidate events), and API support for adding profile fields — indicating a fairly unified candidate record. However, there is no explicit evidence of interview feedback being part of the same unified profile, nor explicit mention of consent status tracking within the candidate record itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of interview feedback stored on the candidate profile, explicit consent/GDPR status field shown in the unified record, independent/hands-on confirmation of a single unified view combining all these elements.
